endpoints.name: Feedback Objects
endpoints.description: The things being rated -- agents, teams or whatever the account configured. Nicereply's abstraction for the subject of a rating, and the dimension per-agent scores are grouped by.

endpoints.name: Feedback Object
endpoints.description: One feedback object by id.

endpoints.name: Feedback Object Responses
endpoints.description: The responses about one feedback object, filterable by date. Requires the object id. The per-agent or per-team score history.

endpoints.name: Feedback Object Groups
endpoints.description: Groupings of feedback objects -- teams of agents, typically. The level above individual subjects.

endpoints.name: Feedback Object Group
endpoints.description: One group by id.

endpoints.name: Feedback Object Group Responses
endpoints.description: The responses about one group, filterable by date. Requires the group id. Team-level satisfaction without summing individuals.

endpoints.name: Customers
endpoints.description: The end customers who gave feedback, with their identifying details. The respondent side of a response.

endpoints.name: Customer
endpoints.description: One customer by id.

endpoints.name: Integrations
endpoints.description: The help desk integrations feeding Nicereply -- Zendesk, Freshdesk and the like -- with their status. The source of the tickets responses are attached to, and the explanation for which conversations get surveyed at all.

endpoints.name: Integration
endpoints.description: One integration by id.

endpoints.name: Questions
endpoints.description: The questions defined across surveys, with their text and type. The wording matters for interpretation, since satisfaction scores are sensitive to how the question is asked.

endpoints.name: Question
endpoints.description: One question by id.

endpoints.name: Rating Values Settings
endpoints.description: The rating scales configured -- what the possible values are and what each means. THE DECODER for the rating column: a 5 on a CSAT scale and a 5 on a ten-point NPS are entirely different results, and nothing in the response row distinguishes them.

endpoints.name: Surveys
endpoints.description: The surveys defined, each with its type (CSAT, CES or NPS), name and status. A survey's TYPE decides how its responses should be aggregated -- NPS is a promoter-minus-detractor calculation, not an average -- so mixing surveys in one average is wrong regardless of scale.

endpoints.name: Survey
endpoints.description: One survey by id, with its type and questions.

endpoints.name: Survey Distribution Settings
endpoints.description: How one survey is sent -- the channel, timing and trigger. Requires a survey id. Explains response rates: a survey sent on every ticket and one sent on a sample produce very different volumes for the same underlying satisfaction.

endpoints.name: Survey Responses
endpoints.description: The responses to one survey, filterable by date. Requires a survey id. The per-survey slice, and the safe unit to aggregate within.

endpoints.name: Responses
endpoints.description: Every customer satisfaction response collected, one row each -- the central table. Carries the rating, any comment, the customer, the agent it was about, the survey it came from, and when it was submitted. Filterable by date. NOTE THE RATING SCALE IS NOT UNIVERSAL: Nicereply supports CSAT, CES and NPS, and their scales differ, so a rating value only means something once its survey's scale is known -- Rating Values Settings is what states it.

endpoints.name: Response
endpoints.description: One response by id, with its rating and comment.

endpoints.name: Response Ticket Link
endpoints.description: The help desk ticket one response relates to. Requires a response id. THE BRIDGE between satisfaction data and the support system -- without it a low score cannot be traced to the conversation that caused it.

endpoints.name: Response Issue Status
endpoints.description: Whether one response has been flagged for follow-up and its current state. Requires a response id. The record of whether a bad rating was actually acted on, which the response itself does not carry.

endpoints.name: Tags
endpoints.description: The tags applied to responses. The free-form categorisation of feedback -- usually where the reason behind a score is recorded, since the numeric rating carries none.

endpoints.name: Tag
endpoints.description: One tag by id.

endpoints.name: Unsubscribes
endpoints.description: The customers who opted out of receiving surveys. They are excluded from future sends, so a falling response count may reflect this list growing rather than any change in satisfaction.

endpoints.name: Unsubscribe
endpoints.description: One unsubscribe record by id.

endpoints.name: Users
endpoints.description: The agents and administrators in the account. Joined to responses through the feedback object, not directly.

endpoints.name: User
endpoints.description: One user by id.

endpoints.name: Tokens
endpoints.description: The API tokens issued for the calling account. Security inventory.
